title: On a running test install, the planner prompt contains a recently closed draft and its reason
description: Starts a real temporary Postgres control plane, creates a planner-origin draft, closes it with a reason, and runs a planner cycle on the empty board; asserts the planner prompt contains the recently closed draft's key, title, and close reason under their own heading.

steps.name: running test install planner prompt contains recently closed draft and reason
